episodes.synopsis: Hakuren's captain, Fubuki Shirou, and his younger brother, Atsuya, are watching the match between Raimon and Seishou Gakuen. However, Mabuka Souji is displeased with Atsuya's behaviour from their previous match.
episodes.title: Story 1: Shirou and Atsuya

episodes.synopsis: Sun Garden and Eisei Gakuen's teacher, Kira Hitomiko, wants to create a soccer club for her students to make their dream of competing in the Football Frontier come true. But her father, Kira Seijirou, is the school's principal and he has a condition to include his troublesome son, Kira Hiroto in the team.
episodes.title: Story 2: The Light and Shadow of the Sun Garden

episodes.synopsis: One year has passed since the Football Frontier; Kageyama Reiji was arrested and Sakuma Jirou became Teikoku Gakuen's captain. The team is getting a new coach and a new member. However, they're someone they never expected.
episodes.title: Story 3: The New Coach of Teikoku Gakuen

episodes.synopsis: After Zeus lost to Raimon in the Football Frontier and the controversy of the team's power, Zeus lost its fame and credit. As the captain, Aphrodi feels responsible for the team and its misery. A mysterious woman then appears and talks to him.
episodes.title: Story 4: I'm not a God

episodes.synopsis: Kidou Yuuto is having a conversation about the future of Japan's youth soccer with his father. But after his butler serves him food, he is shocked about its taste.
episodes.title: Story 5: K's Dining Table

episodes.synopsis: Gouenji Shuuya goes to The Edge, a salon owned by Takita Atsushi, to get his monthly haircut done. Fudou Akio and Kabeyama Heigorou later come to also get a haircut, but Takita wants to do something different with their hair.
episodes.title: Story 6: Spiky Festival
